name: Automax Motors Ltd
summary: Automax Motors Ltd. does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in offering domain monetization and mobile digital advertising services to advertisers, advertising agencies, app developers, and domain owners. The company was formerly known as Matomy Media Group Ltd and changed its name to Automax Motors Ltd. in April 2021. Automax Motors Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
